name: bouncer/git-helper
description: Slash commands for everyday git writing: commit messages, branch names, changelog entries and explaining a diff.

commands.name: commit-message
commands.description: Write a Conventional Commits message for the diff you paste
commands.prompt:
Write a commit message for this diff in the Conventional Commits style: a type, an optional scope and a short summary of at most 72 characters in the imperative, then a blank line and a body that says why the change was made. Only describe what the diff shows.

$ARGUMENTS

commands.name: branch-name
commands.description: Suggest short branch names for a task
commands.prompt:
Suggest three short git branch names for this task. Use lowercase words joined by hyphens, with a prefix such as feat/, fix/ or chore/.

$ARGUMENTS

commands.name: changelog
commands.description: Turn commits or merged PRs into changelog entries
commands.prompt:
Turn these commits or pull requests into changelog entries. Group them under Added, Changed and Fixed. Write each entry as one plain sentence a user would understand, and leave out changes that users cannot see.

$ARGUMENTS

commands.name: explain-diff
commands.description: Explain what a diff does, file by file
commands.prompt:
Explain this diff to a teammate who has not seen it. Say what it does overall, then go file by file. Point out anything that could break.

$ARGUMENTS
